page_note: Pure cosmological substrate page. Continuous teaching about the prow of the sea, established for three works: (1) the sphere winnows/purifies, (2) it provides a fastening to the wheel and zodiac so that powers cannot escape upward, (3) the sea serves as pandocheion gathering wind, water, fire, rivers, rain. Heavy cosmic-mechanism vocabulary (sphere, wheel, zodiac, firmaments, watchers, prow, peg, fastening). No editorial seams, no exhortation, no institutional vocabulary. Damage is significant (62.5%) but every preserved fragment is structural cosmology. The "three works" enumeration is core teaching architecture.
